summary: Nora's doctrine now says her own work computer is not the machine she runs on, and that a job too big for one reply is handed off and announced only once it has started.
details: Before, her identity called the machine underneath her closed while her tools called the sandbox her own computer, and nothing told her when to hand long work off instead of doing it inside the reply.
Her register line no longer names one chat platform or assumes the reply is typed.
limitations: The rest of her register still assumes typing; that waits on the doctrine cut.
